items.criterion: Start from Coursera homepage and perform search for beginner project-management courses
items.description: Agent begins on (or navigates to) Coursera's homepage and uses Coursera search/browsing to look for project-management courses suitable for beginners (via keywords and/or filters). Full credit if the agent makes a clear Coursera-on-site search attempt reflecting 'beginner' + 'project management' intent. Full credit also if Coursera is inaccessible (CAPTCHA/login wall/site error) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and attempts a reasonable workaround within Coursera (e.g., retry, alternate on-site navigation).

items.criterion: Open and identify first relevant beginner project-management course result
items.description: Agent opens one search result page that is a beginner-appropriate project-management course/project-oriented offering on Coursera and identifies its title and provider. Full credit if the course page (or preview/overlay with the same key info) is opened and title/provider are clear. If opening is blocked by login/CAPTCHA/errors, full credit if the agent documents the blocker and uses an available Coursera result card/preview information to identify a plausible first result (or clearly reports that no result pages can be opened). Partial credit if the selected result is only loosely related or beginner suitability is unclear when better options are visible.

items.criterion: Open and identify second relevant beginner project-management course result
items.description: Agent opens a second, distinct beginner-appropriate project-management course result on Coursera and identifies its title and provider. Full credit if it is clearly different from the first and the course page (or preview/overlay) is opened with title/provider visible. If access/opening is blocked, full credit if the agent documents the blocker and uses available Coursera result card/preview information to identify a plausible second distinct result (or clearly reports that a second cannot be opened). Partial credit if it duplicates the first or is not clearly relevant when better options are visible.

items.criterion: Extract required comparison attributes for both courses
items.description: For BOTH opened results, agent captures and reports: provider, rating, estimated duration, level, and main skills taught as shown on the Coursera pages (or result previews if pages cannot be opened). Full credit if all five attributes are provided for both courses OR if any attribute is genuinely not displayed/accessible and the agent explicitly notes it as not listed/blocked rather than guessing. Partial credit if the agent omits attributes that are clearly visible or mixes up attributes between courses. No credit for fabricated values presented as if confirmed on-page.

Agent presents an explicit comparison across provider, rating, duration, level, and skills in a structured format (table or aligned bullets). Full credit if differences are easy to read and attributes are correctly aligned; if some attributes are unavailable due to site/page limitations, full credit if the comparison still clearly marks them as unavailable for the affected course(s). Partial credit if the comparison is hard to follow or misaligned.

items.criterion: Recommend the shorter well-rated option (without enrolling)
items.description: Agent recommends one of the two courses that is shorter in estimated duration while also being well-rated, and explains the choice using the extracted data. Full credit if the recommendation correctly reflects the relative duration and rating; if rating and/or duration are unavailable for one/both courses due to missing on-page info or access blockers, full credit if the agent clearly states the limitation and makes the best-justified recommendation based on the available evidence (e.g., chooses the clearly shorter option and verifies rating when available, or explains why a definitive choice cannot be made). Partial credit if the recommendation is not tied to both criteria when the information is available.

items.criterion: Avoid enrolling or crossing critical commitment steps
items.description: Agent does not enroll, start a paid trial, or complete any sign-up/checkout actions; stays on informational pages only. Full credit if no enrollment/commitment is initiated. Partial credit if the agent clicks an 'Enroll' button but stops before any account/payment/commitment steps and explicitly states they did not enroll. No credit if the agent completes enrollment or initiates a paid trial requiring user commitment.
